name: opencode-zenmux-auth
description: OpenCode / magpie provider plugin: ZenMux Builder Plan — sign in with a subscription API key and a Management API key, chat through ZenMux, and show the plan's rolling 5-hour / 7-day Flows

summary.en: ZenMux's Builder Plan (Free / Pro / Max / Ultra): browser OAuth sign-in or a subscription API key, each model on the protocol it serves best, and the rolling 5-hour and 7-day Flows.
summary.zh: 用 ZenMux 订阅接入 Builder Plan（Free / Pro / Max / Ultra）：支持浏览器 OAuth 登录或订阅 API Key，按模型选择最佳协议，并显示滚动 5 小时 / 7 天 Flows 额度。
